title: UvaXtreme v2.0 - 2nd Runners Up
description: I’m pleased to share that our team, Crud Ops, secured 2nd Runners-Up (First-Year Category) at the UvaXtreme v2.0 Programming Competition 2025, organized by the IEEE Computer Society Student Branch of Uva Wellassa University. This achievement reflects our teamwork, problem-solving, and algorithmic dedication throughout the intense competition.

title: HackMs'25 - Best Performance
description: I’m thrilled to share that our project AMITY was officially awarded Best Performance by the Ms Club of Uva Wellassa University. We engineered AMITY as a centralized Opportunity Hub using Spring Boot and React to help university students discover, filter, and track technical events in real-time, solving fragmented campus information.
